LanguageData.VRE_AcidBurstSack.description: Upon taking large amounts of damage in a single instance, this person will undergo an acid explosion, covering everything and everyone in 4.9 tile radius in corrosive acid, damaging them over time.
LanguageData.VRE_AcidBurstSack.label: acid burstsack
LanguageData.VRE_ChemfuelSacks.description: Chemfuel sacks make this person very volatile. If set on fire, and the fire is at least 35 in size, they explode in a fire explosion. Upon fire explosion, they will not explode again for 24 hours.\n\nWill produce 30 chemfuel every 10 days.
LanguageData.VRE_ChemfuelSacks.label: chemfuel sacks
LanguageData.VRE_Colossal.description: The larger genetic size causes an increase in hunger rate.
LanguageData.VRE_Colossal.label: colossal
LanguageData.VRE_InsectRostrum.comps.0.tools.0.label: insect rostrum
LanguageData.VRE_InsectRostrum.description: A large, sharp beak-like structure akin to that of bees that grants a powerful melee bite attack, dealing significant stab damage with a quick cooldown.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectRostrum.label: insect rostrum
LanguageData.VRE_Microsized.description: The smaller genetic size causes a decrease in hunger rate.
LanguageData.VRE_Microsized.label: microsized
LanguageData.VRE_MineralRichInsectskin.description: Mineral-rich insectskin forming thick, protective plating. This natural armor provides significant protection until enough damage is sustained to break it.
LanguageData.VRE_MineralRichInsectskin.label: mineral-rich insectskin
